title: Breakthrough Product
description: A major product breakthrough sharply improves investor expectations.

title: Major Contract Win
description: The company secures a large multi-year customer contract.

title: International Expansion
description: A successful overseas launch opens a meaningful new growth market.

title: Star CEO Appointment
description: A highly regarded executive takes over and investors price in better execution.

title: Share Buyback
description: Management announces a meaningful share-buyback program.

title: Dividend Initiated
description: The company begins returning cash to shareholders with a modest annual dividend.

title: Regulatory Approval
description: A key product clears an important regulatory hurdle.

title: Product Recall
description: A costly recall damages near-term sales and investor confidence.

title: Major Lawsuit
description: A major legal dispute creates financial and reputational uncertainty.

title: Accounting Probe
description: Regulators open an accounting investigation and investors reassess reported performance.

title: Cybersecurity Incident
description: A serious systems breach disrupts operations and hurts customer trust.

title: Earnings Miss
description: Results fall materially short of market expectations.
